actions.script: String like = search ? search.toLowerCase() : null def policyIds = policyList*.policyId def touchesByPolicy = policyIds ? ec.entity.find('growerp.insurance.RenewalTouch') .condition('policyId', 'in', policyIds).orderBy('touchDate').list() .groupBy { it.policyId } : [:] def partyIds = policyList*.insuredPartyId.unique() def consentsByParty = partyIds ? ec.entity.find('growerp.insurance.CustomerConsent') .condition('partyId', 'in', partyIds).list() .groupBy { it.partyId } : [:] def pcms = partyIds ? ec.entity.find('mantle.party.contact.PartyContactMech') .condition('partyId', 'in', partyIds) .condition('contactMechPurposeId', 'in', ['EmailPrimary', 'PhonePrimary']) .conditionDate('fromDate', 'thruDate', now).list() : [] def accounts = partyIds ? ec.entity.find('moqui.security.UserAccount') .condition('partyId', 'in', partyIds).list() : [] candidates = [] for (policy in policyList) { def name = ec.service.sync().name('growerp.100.InsuranceServices100.get#PartyName') .parameters([partyId: policy.insuredPartyId]).call().name if (like && !(name?.toLowerCase()?.contains(like) || policy.vehiclePlate?.toLowerCase()?.contains(like) || policy.policyNumber?.toLowerCase()?.contains(like))) continue def touches = touchesByPolicy[policy.policyId] ?: [] def consents = (consentsByParty[policy.insuredPartyId] ?: []) .collectEntries { [(it.channelEnumId): it.granted] } def contact = [ hasPhone: pcms.any { it.partyId == policy.insuredPartyId && it.contactMechPurposeId == 'PhonePrimary' }, hasEmail: pcms.any { it.partyId == policy.insuredPartyId && it.contactMechPurposeId == 'EmailPrimary' } || accounts.any { it.partyId == policy.insuredPartyId && it.emailAddress }] ec.context.putAll([policy: policy, touches: touches, consents: consents, contact: contact, now: now]) Map s = ec.resource.script('component://growerp/service/insurance/scoreRenewal.groovy', null) as Map if (band && s.band != band) continue def last = touches ? touches[-1] : null candidates.add([policyId: policy.policyId, pseudoId: policy.pseudoId, policyNumber: policy.policyNumber, insuredPartyId: policy.insuredPartyId, insuredName: name, vehiclePlate: policy.vehiclePlate, vehicleDescription: policy.vehicleDescription, policyTypeEnumId: policy.policyTypeEnumId, statusId: policy.statusId, expirationDate: ec.l10n.format(policy.expirationDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ssZ'), daysToExpiry: s.daysToExpiry, score: s.score, band: s.band, reasons: s.reasons, nextChannelEnumId: s.nextChannelEnumId, nextAction: s.nextAction, nextTime: s.nextTime, completeness: s.completeness, missing: s.missing, stage: s.stage, consentChannels: consents.findAll { it.value == 'Y' }.collect { it.key }, lastEventEnumId: last?.eventEnumId, lastChannelEnumId: last?.channelEnumId, lastTouchDate: last ? ec.l10n.format(last.touchDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ssZ') : null, touchCount: touches.size()]) } // best first; done and stopped last def rank = [High: 0, Medium: 1, Low: 2, Done: 3, Stop: 4] candidates.sort { a, b -> (rank[a.band] <=> rank[b.band]) ?: (b.score <=> a.score) ?: (a.daysToExpiry <=> b.daysToExpiry) } candidates = candidates.drop(start).take(limit)

service.description: A synthetic TNDS renewal book for the demo, clearly fake data: individual drivers with Vietnamese names, plates, phone and email (example.com, never mailed), channel consents, policies ending from 10 days ago to 60 days ahead (some renewed with us before) and a reminder history so the scores and the funnel have something to show. Run with the tenant admin logged in (from load#InsuranceDemoData).

actions.script: def rnd = new Random(20261015) long day = 24L * 3600L * 1000L def now = ec.user.nowTimestamp def noon = java.sql.Timestamp.valueOf(java.time.LocalDate.now(java.time.ZoneOffset.UTC).atTime(12, 0)) def at = { int days -> new java.sql.Timestamp(noon.time + days * day) } def pick = { List l -> l[rnd.nextInt(l.size())] } List lastNames = ['Nguyễn', 'Trần', 'Lê', 'Phạm', 'Hoàng', 'Huỳnh', 'Phan', 'Vũ', 'Võ', 'Đặng', 'Bùi', 'Đỗ'] List middle = ['Văn', 'Thị', 'Minh', 'Quốc', 'Thanh', 'Ngọc', 'Hữu', 'Đức'] List firstNames = ['An', 'Bình', 'Chi', 'Dũng', 'Giang', 'Hà', 'Hải', 'Hạnh', 'Hùng', 'Huy', 'Khoa', 'Lan', 'Linh', 'Long', 'Mai', 'Minh', 'Nam', 'Ngọc', 'Phúc', 'Quân', 'Sơn', 'Thảo', 'Trang', 'Trung', 'Tuấn', 'Vy'] List prefixes = ['51K', '51H', '30A', '30G', '29H', '43A', '92A', '65A'] List vehicles = ['Toyota Vios', 'Hyundai Accent', 'Kia Morning', 'Mazda CX-5', 'VinFast VF 5', 'Geely Coolray', 'Honda City', 'Ford Ranger', 'Toyota Corolla Cross', 'Mitsubishi Xpander'] List colours = ['trắng', 'bạc', 'đen', 'đỏ', 'xám', 'xanh'] def create = { String name, Map params -> ec.service.sync().name(name).parameters(params).call() } for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) { String first = pick(firstNames), last = pick(lastNames) def party = create('create#mantle.party.Party', [partyTypeEnumId: 'PtyPerson', ownerPartyId: ownerPartyId, pseudoId: 'SYN' + String.format('%03d', i + 1)]) String partyId = party.partyId // Vietnamese order: family and middle name first, the given name last (and // the given name is how the customer is addressed) create('create#mantle.party.Person', [partyId: partyId, firstName: last + ' ' + pick(middle), lastName: first]) create('create#mantle.party.PartyRole', [partyId: partyId, roleTypeId: 'Customer']) if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 90) create('mantle.party.ContactServices.create#TelecomNumber', [partyId: partyId, contactMechPurposeId: 'PhonePrimary', countryCode: '84', contactNumber: '9' + String.format('%08d', rnd.nextInt(100000000))]) if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 60) create('mantle.party.ContactServices.create#EmailAddress', [partyId: partyId, contactMechPurposeId: 'EmailPrimary', emailAddress: "synthetic${i + 1}@example.com"]) // channel consents, as collected at the dealer or in the VETC app Map consents = [InchZalo: 72, InchVetc: 55, InchSms: 60, InchEmail: 40, InchCall: 45] .findAll { rnd.nextInt(100) < it.value } if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 8) consents = [:] consents.each { ch, pct -> create('create#growerp.insurance.CustomerConsent', [partyId: partyId, channelEnumId: ch, granted: 'Y', consentDate: at(-300 - rnd.nextInt(200)), source: ch == 'InchVetc' ? 'VETC app' : 'dealer contract'])} int ends = -10 + rnd.nextInt(71) String plate = pick(prefixes) + '-' + String.format('%03d', rnd.nextInt(1000)) + '.' + String.format('%02d', rnd.nextInt(100)) String vehicle = pick(vehicles) + ' ' + (2016 + rnd.nextInt(9)) + ', ' + pick(colours) Map policyMap = [insuredPartyId: partyId, carrierPartyId: pick(carrierIds), policyTypeEnumId: 'InptMotorCompulsory', premiumAmount: 480700, currencyUomId: 'VND', premiumFrequencyEnumId: 'InpfAnnual', commissionRate: 5, vehiclePlate: plate, vehicleDescription: vehicle, policyNumber: 'TNDS-' + (60300 + i), description: 'Synthetic demo customer', // the limits of Decree 67/2023 for cars, in VND coverages: [[coverageName: 'Third party bodily injury, per person', limitAmount: 150000000, deductibleAmount: 0], [coverageName: 'Third party property damage, per accident', limitAmount: 100000000, deductibleAmount: 0]]] String previousId = null if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 45) { // with us last year as well def prev = create('growerp.100.InsuranceServices100.create#Policy', [policy: policyMap + [effectiveDate: at(ends - 730), expirationDate: at(ends - 365), statusId: 'InpsRenewed']]) previousId = prev.policy.policyId } def created = create('growerp.100.InsuranceServices100.create#Policy', [policy: policyMap + [effectiveDate: at(ends - 365), expirationDate: at(ends), statusId: ends < 0 ? 'InpsLapsed' : ends <= 30 ? 'InpsRenewalDue' : 'InpsActive']]) String policyId = created.policy.policyId if (previousId) { def p = ec.entity.find('growerp.insurance.Policy').condition('policyId', policyId).one() p.renewedFromPolicyId = previousId; p.update() } // reminder history for those due within 45 days List chans = consents.keySet().findAll { it in ['InchZalo', 'InchVetc', 'InchSms', 'InchEmail'] } as List if (ends > 45 || !chans || rnd.nextInt(100) >= 75) continue def touch = { String ev, String ch, int daysAgo, int hour, Map extra = [:] -> create('create#growerp.insurance.RenewalTouch', [ownerPartyId: ownerPartyId, policyId: policyId, channelEnumId: ch, eventEnumId: ev, touchDate: new java.sql.Timestamp(noon.time - daysAgo * day + (hour - 19) * 3600000L)] + extra) } String ch = pick(chans) int sentAgo = 3 + rnd.nextInt(8) int hour = pick([7, 12, 19, 20, 21]) touch('InevSent', ch, sentAgo, 9, [messageText: 'Synthetic reminder']) if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 30) touch('InevSent', ch, Math.max(0, sentAgo - 3), 9, [messageText: 'Synthetic reminder']) if (rnd.nextInt(100) >= 58) continue touch('InevOpened', ch, sentAgo, hour) if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 6) { touch('InevOptOut', 'InchWeb', sentAgo, hour); continue } if (rnd.nextInt(100) >= 55) continue touch('InevVisited', 'InchWeb', sentAgo, hour) if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 15) { touch('InevCallback', 'InchWeb', sentAgo, hour); continue } if (rnd.nextInt(100) >= 70) continue touch('InevConfirmed', 'InchWeb', sentAgo, hour) if (rnd.nextInt(100) >= 65) continue touch('InevRenewRequested', 'InchWeb', sentAgo, hour) if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 60) { touch('InevRenewed', 'InchCall', Math.max(0, sentAgo - 1), 10) touch('InevIssued', 'InchCall', Math.max(0, sentAgo - 1), 10) } }
